title: Stuck on Red? Understanding GitHub Actions Failing Streaks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GitHub Actions is the de facto CI/CD service for GitHub repositories. Its workflows should not fail when they are not expected to, nor keep on failing too long. We empirically study failing streaks, i.e., uninterrupted series of failing runs of a workflow, in 30.9M+ runs of 154K+ workflows of 43K+ GitHub repositories over 238 days. We study how failing streaks begin and end, and what happens during them, based on the trigger and the commit of each run. We also classify all workflows by their purposes, such as building, testing or deploying, and we inspect the logs of a small sample of failing streaks. Failing runs mostly come in streaks: three quarters of them follow another failing run, and half of the workflows with at least three runs have at least one failing streak. translated_title: 困在红色状态？理解 GitHub Actions 的连续失败现象
translated_abstract: GitHub Actions 是 GitHub 仓库事实上的 CI/CD 服务。工作流不应在非预期的情况下失败，也不应持续失败过久。我们对 43K+ 个 GitHub 仓库中 154K+ 个工作流的 3090 万余次运行进行了为期 238 天的实证研究，研究对象是“失败连续期”，即工作流连续不断失败的运行序列。我们基于每次运行的触发方式和提交内容，研究失败连续期如何开始、如何结束以及期间发生了什么。我们还按用途（如构建、测试或部署）对所有工作流进行分类，并检查了一小部分失败连续期的日志。研究发现，失败的运行大多以连续期的形式出现：其中四分之三紧跟在另一次失败的运行之后，而在至少有三次运行的工作流中，一半以上至少经历过一次失败连续期。服务于多种用途的工作流更容易出现失败连续期，即使规模相同也是如此。大多数失败连续期在数小时内结束，但仍有五分之一的失败连续期持续了更长的时间。
tldr: 该论文首次对 GitHub Actions 工作流的“失败连续期”开展了超大规模实证研究（覆盖 3000 多万次运行），揭示了失败运行往往接连发生、多用途工作流更易陷入长期失败等规律。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of GitHub Actions failing streaks across 30.9M+ runs, revealing that failing runs tend to occur in streaks and that multi-purpose workflows are more prone to prolonged failing streaks.
